note: Plan shepherding visits together, live: a planning page you and the elders open at the same time, where everyone sees each change at once (your private notes and the brothers' reports stay in your app). Follow-up visits: plan visit 2, 3 and more, linked to the first, and choose when you want the reminder (1 to 6 weeks after a visit). A reminder when a visit is still not done 2 weeks after its date. Group overseer summaries now show who conducted Bible studies, who didn't, and pioneers with fewer than 2 studies. Also in version 39: Automatic sync fixed: your phone and laptop no longer keep sending to each other ("Synced: 0 new, 1 updated" over and over). Each device keeps its own alarms and timer, and every small change is now noticed. New: Shepherding schedule on the Publishers tab: plan a visit to one publisher or a whole family with two brothers (two elders, or an elder with a ministerial servant); your private note goes only to those two, each through his own link; they tick Done, add a short report and send it back on WhatsApp; a schedule PDF to share shows only who visits whom, the date and the purpose. New: "Cards for this group": all the S-21 cards of one field service group for the service year you choose, in one PDF for the service overseer. Also in version 38: Automatic sync between your phone and laptop: after a one-time setup, changes on one device appear on the other by themselves whenever you are online. Your data is locked with your own passphrase before it leaves the device. Also in version 37: Ministry time in hours and minutes, My secretary settings (your own wording, lists, reminders, PDF text), save your own letter wording, memos and operating committee meetings, project contributions with progress, baptism anniversary messages, monthly good news, PDFs now send properly on WhatsApp. Also: backup reminder, regular pioneers on track (600 h) and auxiliary pioneers (30 or 15 h), inactive and reactivation list, group summaries for overseers, end of service year checklist, shepherding calls due. Also: every publisher's report by group in one PDF, sharing chosen parts now always locked, CO programme separate from partners and lunch, black and white printing, signatures with phone numbers, roles and assignments on each publisher. Also: remarks box for each publisher on the group report link (goes onto the S-21), total head count and notes on the attendance checklist for the S-88, a No meeting button for conventions, and meeting days on the checklist. Also: choose your own colours and app name (asked at setup, changeable in Settings), PDFs in your colour, and the attendant checklist locks each meeting after it is sent. Also: wedding letter asking another congregation for its Kingdom Hall, a Letters received log with dates and reply reminders, and one dated letter log. Also everything in version 31: letters with 3 wordings (one publisher or a family, signed by 3 elders, JW Hub), branch letters with reminders, meeting minutes with action points, CO visit planner, contact list PDF, attendance checklist with 2-miss alerts, full package sharing, locked backups.
